buyer_question: Why is my restaurant food cost too high even though sales look okay?
safe_aics_answer: Start by separating recipe/POS mapping, stock-count variance, wastage reason codes, supplier purchase variance and complimentary/void rules before buying another app.
owner_evidence_to_prepare: Redacted menu category list; stock-count template; purchase-summary example; manager-approved wastage reason codes
unsafe_claims_to_block: Do not claim theft, fraud, supplier fault, margin improvement, savings, ROI or accounting/tax correctness without independent owner/adviser evidence.
next_step: Build a no-credentials owner evidence queue from sanitized category-level rows.

buyer_question: Should I buy inventory software or fix my POS first?
safe_aics_answer: If menu items, modifiers, combos, portion units or recipe costs are not mapped consistently, software dashboards may amplify confusion instead of resolving it.
owner_evidence_to_prepare: Sample menu/POS screenshots without customer data; recipe-unit notes; category mapping gaps; owner approval rules
unsafe_claims_to_block: Do not endorse or rank POS, ERP, inventory apps, consultants or vendors as better/worse from this synthetic asset.
next_step: Create a tool-neutral comparison of data readiness before software selection.

buyer_question: Can AI detect restaurant wastage or staff misuse automatically?
safe_aics_answer: AI should not accuse staff or suppliers. First define approved wastage codes, evidence sources, review owners and human approval gates.
owner_evidence_to_prepare: Wastage log template; role-based review owner; photo policy if applicable; escalation thresholds
unsafe_claims_to_block: Do not claim automated detection, staff performance conclusions, fraud proof, food-safety compliance or legal defensibility.
next_step: Use AI only after owner-approved controls and human review boundaries exist.

buyer_question: What can I share for a first food-cost review without exposing sensitive data?
safe_aics_answer: Use redacted category summaries, stock-count examples, screenshots, supplier-summary ranges and owner notes; do not share POS passwords, payroll, bank, tax or customer payment data.
owner_evidence_to_prepare: Redacted CSV; screenshots with names/payments hidden; list of systems; current review cadence
unsafe_claims_to_block: Do not request credentials, customer payment data, payroll, bank data, tax files or confidential supplier contracts for first scoping.
next_step: Run a no-credentials review to define the safe evidence pack.

buyer_question: How do I know whether food wastage, recipe costing or supplier variance is the real issue?
safe_aics_answer: Compare owner-approved rows across prep waste, buffet/expiry waste, recipe-unit mismatch, purchase variance, voids and POS reconciliation before deciding the fix lane.
owner_evidence_to_prepare: Category-level variance log; reason codes; purchase summary; stock count dates; owner sign-off notes
unsafe_claims_to_block: Do not claim the root cause, savings amount, margin impact or operational remedy from synthetic examples alone.
next_step: Turn the evidence into an owner decision matrix with hold, review and adviser lanes.
